note: Real-time layer, one row per 15 minutes: MILP re-planned every 15 minutes from the actual state of charge, together with the shiftable devices not yet running (a device starts when the plan says 'now' and then runs to the end), then the group's step_1sec_control run for 900 seconds against measured load and PV; values are the 900-second averages, soc_pct is at the end of the slot. devices: 1 where the device runs (load_kw includes it at rated power); planned: for devices not yet running, the start slot (0-95) planned at that slot, else null.
